lines.text: I'm running on fumes after finals week.

data.define: Used when you keep going even though you are almost empty of energy.

example.text: I'm running on fumes after finals week.

misuse.text: Don't say 'running on fumes' when fully rested.

publish.title: What does "running on fumes" mean?
publish.value: Running on fumes = Almost no energy left. Example: "I'm running on fumes after finals week." (casual English).
